The Buyer shall have the right to terminate this Contract in part or i n full in any of the following cases:- (a) The delivery of the item is delayed for causes not attributable to Force Majeure after the scheduled date of delivery. (b) The Seller is declared bankrupt or becomes insolvent. The Supplier shall not assign, either in whole or in part, it contract ual duties, responsibilities and obligations to perform the contract to any other individual or agency, except with the TIAs prior permission. 13. (a) Neither party shall bear responsibility for the complete or partial non-performance of any of its obligations (except for failure to pay any sum which has become due on account of receipt of item under the provisions of the present contract), if the non-performance results from such Force Majeure circumstances as Flood, Fire, Earth Quake and other acts of God as well as War, Military o peration, blockade, Acts or Actions of State Authorities or any other circumstances beyond the par ties control that have arisen after the conclusion of the present contract. (b) In such circumstances the time stipulated for the performance of an obligation under the present contract is extended correspondingly for the period of time of action of these circumstance s and their consequences. (d) Certificate of a Chamber of Commerce (Commerce and Industry) or other competent aut hority or organization of the respective country shall be a sufficient proof of commencement and c essation of the above circumstances. posals and the price payable under the contract for the item of such reduction of sale or offer of th e sale shall stand correspondingly reduced. General Terms and Definitions: (a) "BIDDER" (SELLER / SERVICE PROVIDER) shall mean any eligible legal entity (as given above) participating in procurement process with a BUYER. (b) "ALLIED FIRM" (‘affiliates’ / ‘affiliated firm’, ‘sister concern’, ‘associated firm’, or ‘rel ated party’) of a bidder is a firm/concern that comes within the sphere of effective control/influenc e of the principal firm, wherein the Principal Firm – (i) Being a proprietary firm, owns the Allied Firm; (ii) Being a partnership firm, has common (all or majority of) partners, or any one of its partners has profit share of 20% or more, in the Allied Firm; (iii) Has common Management (say majority of director) with the Allied Firm; (iv) It is partners or directors have a majority interest in the management of the Allied Firm; (v) Has a controlling voice by owning substantial (20% or more) shares in the Allied Firm;

(vi) Directly or indirectly controls or is controlled by or is under common control, by way of any agreement/ MoU or otherwise with the Allied Firm; (vii) Has the Allied Firm as its successor/ subsidiary or vice-versa; (viii) Has common offices/ manufacturing facilities with the Allied Firm. 30. Further, OEMs are required to independently communicate details of factori es / manufacturing premises which are assessed by GeM to reseller(s) for compliance of the abov e. (b) Age Eligibility and Legal Capacity: The GeM portal is intended for access and use onl y by persons who have attained the age of eighteen (18) years and/or are competent to contract in accordance with the provisions of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 and other applicable laws in In dia. By accessing, registering on, or using the GeM portal, any person shall be deemed to represe nt and warrant that they satisfy the aforesaid requirements of age and legal capacity. Any access to or use of the portal by a person who is a minor or otherwise not competent to contract under t he applicable laws, shall be deemed unauthorised and in violation of this GTC. GeM reserves the r ight to take appropriate administrative or legal action, including suspension or deactivation of acc ount / access. 31. Enabling provisions of Rule 149 of General Financial Rules – 2025 (a) E-Bidding and Reverse Auction (RA) on GeM :- (i) The Seller participating in the e-bidding / RA may offer any one of their pro duct(s) already listed on GeM. Use of Aadhaar Number in GeM: Aadhaar authentication on the Government eMarketplace ( GeM) is undertaken solely for the limited purpose of establishing the identity of a user at the time of regist ration, in accordance with the provisions of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidie s, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 and the rules and regulations framed thereunder. In furtherance of data minimization principles, GeM does not receive or store the Aadhaar number. Users are facilitated to authen ticate themselves using a Virtual Aadhaar ID, pursuant to which only such demographic information as is e xpressly permitted under law; namely first name, last name, date of birth and registered mobile number is received. The mobile number so obtained is used exclusively for enabling secure user authentication and t ransaction validation, including the generation of one-time passwords (OTPs), to ensure integrity, auditabili ty, and non-repudiation of electronic records and artefacts generated on the GeM platform. In compliance with the extant legal framework, GeM has provisioned an alternative identity verification mechanism, inclu ding PAN-based verification, particularly for Sellers. 33.
